$comment: Traditional public-domain tunes, arranged for the in-game band (fiddle, whistle, plucked bass, harp, drums). Melody tokens are note+octave/beats (e.g. A4/0.5) or r/beats for a rest; | marks a bar and every full bar must add up to beatsPerBar. Chords are one per bar (or chord/beats). The shanties are 19th century, an accepted anachronism for 1660; Greensleeves and Scarborough Fair are period ballads.
